guidance.eligibilityNarrative: FHA-insured forward mortgage path for owner-occupant scenarios with policy-driven credit, collateral, and mortgage-insurance execution controls.
keyRequirements: Primary occupancy and FHA case assignment compliance.
Minimum investment and MI premium treatment.
documentationExpectations: Income and asset verification with FHA treatment rules.
Property appraisal and MPR/MPS compliance evidence.
edgeCases: Manual-underwrite with high DTI and limited reserves.
commonDenialReasons: DTI/residual capacity outside lender overlay tolerance.
overlayCaveats: Lenders often apply stricter DTI/credit overlays than FHA baseline.
Manual underwrite may trigger reserve overlays.
compensatingFactors: Strong residual cash flow and payment history.
Lower payment shock and stable income trend.
workflowNotes: Confirm MIP structure and disclosures early.

guidance.eligibilityNarrative: FHA streamline refinance path emphasizing net tangible benefit, seasoning/payment-history standards, and limited documentation execution per current FHA policy and investor overlays.
keyRequirements: Existing FHA-insured loan with required payment history/seasoning.
Net tangible benefit and recoupment criteria satisfied.
documentationExpectations: Payment history support and current loan details.
NTB worksheet and rate/term comparison evidence.
edgeCases: Recent delinquency history and timing concerns.
Overlay seasoning requirements beyond FHA baseline.
overlayCaveats: Investors may apply stricter credit overlays to streamline loans.
Manual downgrade or reduced-doc restrictions can differ by investor.
compensatingFactors: Strong payment history with measurable monthly benefit.
workflowNotes: Validate NTB and recoupment before lock.
Track investor-specific streamline overlays at intake.

guidance.eligibilityNarrative: FHA 203(k) limited renovation path for owner-occupied properties with capped rehab scope and project controls.
keyRequirements: Primary occupancy and eligible limited-rehab scope.
Contractor package and repair plan support.
As-completed value and draw controls per policy.
edgeCases: Ineligible repair scope for limited program variant.
commonDenialReasons: Overlay reserve or credit standards not met.
overlayCaveats: Investors may tighten documentation and reserve standards for renovation files.
compensatingFactors: Strong reserves and conservative leverage profile.
Complete contractor package with clear timeline.
workflowNotes: Validate rehab scope and contractor docs before underwriting.
Coordinate draw tracking with closing and post-close.
